chapters.title: 1. The Case for Expectations Investing
chapters.summary:
In The Case for Expectations Investing, the chapter opens with a precise human scene that makes the larger argument testable. The author places that moment in a specific setting — a date, a room, a workshop, or a trading floor — so causality can be inspected rather than assumed. One illustration reproduces the physical artefact of the scene, whether a laboratory notebook, a factory ticket, or a street photograph, annotated to highlight what a casual observer would miss. A companion visual quantifies the context, often a timeline or map that locates the anecdote inside a longer arc of policy or prices. Together the story and two figures establish stakes and method, inviting the reader to carry a concrete reference forward while the conceptual machinery is built in the next section.

Next, the author articulates the core framework in operational terms, translating an intuition into questions that can be asked before action. For The Case for Expectations Investing the questions concern what is being assumed, what evidence would falsify the story, and what structure determines whether a good insight can be acted upon. An explanatory figure makes the framework visible, typically as a two-by-two, a pipeline, or an expected-value tree where each node is labeled with a test. A second illustration displays relevant history as a distribution or time series, allowing the reader to see how often the mechanism has produced its promised outcome and where it failed. The chapter notes what the framework does not claim, including the role of luck and the cost of applying a powerful tool to a weak problem.

To avoid single-story bias, 1. The Case for Expectations Investing develops a second detailed example that differs in domain or in outcome. The account names the decision-maker, quotes the reasoning at the time, and records the data available before the result was known, preserving the uncertainty that the outcome later erases. A second illustration presents the instrument of discipline — a promise log, a kill thesis, or a calibrated dashboard — reproduced so its use can be imitated. The synthesis returns to the book's thesis to state the crux without hedging.
